title: Polynomial-time clean verifier
statement: Let $V$ be a language of Boolean words in polynomial time. Then there are natural numbers $e,c_V$ and a finite Boolean Turing machine $M_V$ such that, for every Boolean word $y$, the clean simulation of $M_V$ started in its initialization state on $y$ halts with output consisting of the single indicator bit of whether $y$ belongs to $V$. At its halting time all work-tape cells are blank and all work-tape heads are at the origin; throughout the run, every head position has absolute value at most $c_V(|y|^e+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: The language $V$ belongs to polynomial time
